external.the_rule_that_travels: ⚠ STATE THE ARTIFACT BEFORE THE CONVENTION. 'NavSim publishes X' is not a claim until you say WHICH publication: the PAPER truncates to 1 dp, the LEADERBOARD rounds to 4 dp. They do not disagree -- they are different renderings of the same number, and quoting one convention against the other source manufactures a mismatch (or, as here, a false agreement).
